.github/workflows/release.yml:28:          test "$(jq -r '.verification.verified' <<<"$tag")" = true
.github/workflows/release.yml:29:          test "$(jq -r '.object.type' <<<"$tag")" = commit
.github/workflows/release.yml:30:          commit=$(jq -r '.object.sha' <<<"$tag")
.github/workflows/release.yml:31:          test "$commit" = "$EXPECTED"
